fifth-ocean.title: Fifth Ocean
fifth-ocean.summary: A travel company website in Kherson with catalogs, offers and ongoing support.
fifth-ocean.body:
One of my first complete commercial projects. I integrated an existing layout with Joomla 3 and developed catalogs and travel offer pages.

After launch I maintained the website, fixed bugs and restored it after attacks and intrusion attempts. This was a transition from experiments to building and supporting a real product.

autocity.title: AutoCity
autocity.summary: Contributions to an automotive platform with a large vehicle and compatible parts database.
autocity.body:
I joined an existing large project rather than building the entire platform from scratch. My work covered catalogs, filtering and automotive parts functionality.

Selecting a make, year, body type and model narrowed the results to compatible parts. The project introduced me to team development on a production system with a large database.

call-center.title: Call-center / Real-time Status Module
call-center.role: Existing system improvements · original real-time module author
call-center.summary: A real-time module showing call-center status and operator availability.
call-center.body:
I contributed to an existing Yii2 call-center system and independently implemented its status and operator availability module using JavaScript and WebSocket.

A key challenge was maintaining a reliable HTTPS/WSS connection. Another developer later rewrote the module in Node.js; this entry describes my original implementation, not authorship of the entire call center.

vezdevoz.title: Vezdevoz
vezdevoz.role: Full Stack Developer · Inceptium / StarFix · turnkey delivery
vezdevoz.summary: A shared freight service matching routes with loads that can be picked up along the way.
vezdevoz.body:
I implemented almost the entire service from the beginning to a working product. Carriers entered routes, while customers could find vehicles already heading in the right direction and use spare capacity.

I repeatedly cleaned and restructured a purchased worldwide cities, regions and countries database for fast search. Google Maps API calculated routes, distance, direction and travel time.

platcms.title: PlatCMS / PlatP CMS
platcms.summary: A lightweight modular CMS used to build more than twenty websites.
platcms.body:
Development began in August 2017 after the rights to my previous system were purchased. The architecture drew on OpenCart and ShopScript, with support for adapting OpenCart plugins with minimal changes.

I built SEO, landing page, payment, tag, PDF, localization, event, template, error and settings modules. More than twenty websites used the CMS. I later stopped development as modern frameworks became more efficient for the same tasks.

comfort-club.title: Comfort Club
comfort-club.summary: An interactive residential complex catalog, from buildings and floors to apartment layouts.
comfort-club.body:
The first commercial website on the new PlatCMS version, delivered in December 2017. A simple interface concealed a hierarchy of buildings, entrances, floors and apartments.

Visitors selected a building on an image and explored floors, apartment sizes, plans and photos. The administration area managed the complete hierarchy; window views were displayed when materials were available.

oncoplastic-surgery.title: Oncoplastic Surgery
oncoplastic-surgery.summary: A landing page with contact forms and payment processing.
oncoplastic-surgery.body:
I built a compact commercial website with contact forms and integrated payment processing.

It marked an important PlatCMS milestone: payment plugins first appeared in the engine in February 2018. The mechanism could then be reused and extended for other projects.

dolce-bella.title: Dolce Bella
dolce-bella.role: Commercial website for a beauty salon network
dolce-bella.summary: A Kherson salon network website with booking and service landing pages.
dolce-bella.body:
The project included multiple salons, booking functionality and separate landing pages for services and business areas.

These tasks helped develop PlatCMS SEO features: metadata, page structure and search promotion. Dolce Bella was one of the projects that grew the small CMS into a set of reusable business tools.

fish-meat.title: Meat & Fish
fish-meat.summary: A restaurant menu with configurable dishes, ingredients, preorders and table reservations.
fish-meat.body:
For a restaurant in Saint Petersburg, I built a detailed menu where visitors could customize dishes such as pizzas. Ingredients were independent entities with their own photos and descriptions.

Dishes, categories and ingredients formed a network of relationships. The project included reservations and preorders and expanded PlatCMS catalogs, tags and entity relationships.

prime.title: Prime / InfoRegion
prime.summary: A website for three fitness clubs with trainers and time-based booking.
prime.body:
I developed a website for three fitness clubs in Kherson. Each club had its own trainers, and visitors could select a specialist and book a time slot.

The site connected branches, staff and schedules, adapting PlatCMS to fitness clubs. It belongs to the 2016–2021 freelance period; the exact year has not yet been recovered.

antosh-co.title: Antosh & Co
antosh-co.role: Public landing page and private internal system
antosh-co.summary: A private specialist marketplace behind a company's public landing page.
antosh-co.body:
The public website was the front for a restricted internal tool. Authorized users could find available specialists, including programmers and markup developers, for specific tasks.

Most functionality lived in the private area for people working with the project owner. The project was built on PlatCMS and dates to January 2020.

haukun.title: Haukun
haukun.summary: Radius-based product and classified search with maps and payments.
haukun.body:
Visitors selected a city and radius, such as Berlin and 50 km, before searching for a product. The system identified the geographic area and returned matching offers.

An external geographic API translated coordinates and radii into settlements, then the internal database searched their listings. Google Maps API and payment plugins were also used. The project dates to September 2020.

tourist-booking.title: Tourist Booking Platform
tourist-booking.role: Major improvements to an existing project · Israel
tourist-booking.summary: Reworked excursion booking with participants, transfers and return options.
tourist-booking.body:
I took over an existing WordPress travel website and reworked a substantial part of its functionality. It offered excursions to travelers staying at selected hotels.

Bookings accounted for adults and children, the excursion and transfers. Guests could return to their hotel or choose another drop-off point. The title is provisional: the original name and exact year within 2016–2021 have not yet been recovered.

colortech.title: ColorTech ERP / WMS
colortech.summary: Recovery of a manufacturer's ERP/WMS and barcode-based materials receiving.
colortech.body:
I worked on an existing system for a Czech metal processing and painting company. I investigated the architecture, entry points and relationships between ERP, WMS Desktop and WMS Mobile, partially restoring operation.

A separate workstream involved mobile materials receiving: employees scanned barcodes to identify items for warehouse accounting. My contribution was recovery and adaptation, not building the original ERP from scratch.

service-market.title: ServiceMarket
service-market.summary: A large appliance, electronics and spare parts store with catalogs and order processing.
service-market.body:
I helped build the core project: initialized the application structure, integrated existing templates, developed catalogs and implemented a substantial share of the main functionality. In my estimation, roughly half the project was complete at the next-stage handover.

The catalog included many categories, filters, product pages and order processing. Redis and Elasticsearch belong to the project stack, but another developer primarily configured them.

smartmag.title: SmartMag
smartmag.summary: An electronics and appliance store with filtering, comparison and order tracking.
smartmag.body:
The architecture was close to ServiceMarket, with a more compact range of smartphones, accessories, power banks and household appliances.

Customers could filter and compare products, place orders and track them. The project used caching and search mechanisms, continuing my work with Laravel-based e-commerce and reusable catalog and order logic.

tcars.title: Tesla / TCarService
tcars.summary: Tesla vehicles, used cars, spare parts and service requests for the US market.
tcars.body:
The platform served a company working with Tesla vehicles in the US market. It combined vehicle listings, used cars, spare parts and service offerings.

Users could browse offers, use categories and filters and submit maintenance or diagnostics requests. The project belonged to the same family of Laravel e-commerce solutions as SmartMag and ServiceMarket.

hmh-expert.title: HMH Expert
hmh-expert.summary: A B2B platform combining products, services, orders and a corporate messenger.
hmh-expert.body:
I worked on authentication and registration services, a message manager using Matrix Synapse, WebSocket and React, and revisions to the API and authentication architecture.

The platform connected companies and small businesses through listings, orders and communication. Tasks spanned frontend, backend, real-time messaging, queues, separate databases and file storage. My NicelyGroup period was May–November 2025.
